intro: Welcome to Quiz Rush! Forty questions, four levels, ten seconds each. Grab a pen, keep your score, and let's go!
q: Let's warm up! Which city is home to this famous tower?
Cute one coming up. What is this animal?
Look up at the sky. Which planet is this?
Ancient wonder alert! In which country are these pyramids?
Big city lights. What is the capital of Japan?
Sports fans, this one's yours. How many players per team are on the court in basketball?
Deep breath. What is the largest ocean on Earth?
Picture this bridge. Which city is it famous for?
Think about the map. How many continents are usually counted?
Last easy one! Which gas do plants absorb from the air?
Level up! Welcome to the Medium round. In which country is this ancient site?
Careful, this one tricks a lot of people. What is the capital of Australia?
Shiny question! What is the hardest natural material?
Let's head to Africa. Which is the longest river on the continent?
A monument to love. In which country is it?
Kick-off time! How many players does a soccer team have on the field?
Chemistry class! What is the chemical symbol for gold?
Ready, set, run! What is the fastest land animal?
Those white sails are iconic. In which country is this opera house?
Final Medium question. What is the largest planet in our solar system?
You made it to the Hard round! In which country is this ancient city?
Small step, giant leap. In which year did humans first land on the Moon?
Think tiny. What is the smallest country in the world?
Snow at the equator? In which country is this mountain?
Not the biggest city! What is the capital of Canada?
Your body knows this one. How many bones are in the adult human body?
A famous gift. Which country gave this statue to the United States?
Back to the periodic table. Which element has the symbol F E?
Gladiators, get ready! In which city is this ancient arena?
Last Hard question. What is the largest hot desert in the world?
This is it, the Genius round! Which country has the most lakes?
Only true geography experts know this. What is the capital of Mongolia?
A weird one from space. Which planet rotates on its side?
Sunrise over a legend. In which country is this temple?
Wings out! Which is the only mammal capable of true flight?
Back to where it all started. Which city hosted the first modern Olympic Games?
Listen closely. Which language has the most native speakers?
How deep can you go? What is the deepest lake in the world?
Almost there! What is the capital of New Zealand?
Final question! How long does sunlight take to reach Earth?
